entities.name: Message too short
entities.description: A condition where a received message is too short to contain a complete message type information element.

entities.name: Message type information element
entities.description: The information element that identifies the type of message being transmitted.

entities.name: Ignore message
entities.description: The system behavior of discarding a message that does not meet protocol requirements.

relations.description: The condition of message being too short is determined by the absence of a complete message type IE.
When a message is too short, it triggers the ignore action as specified by the protocol.
